_about: Enemy squads (SPEC §17). Every enemy squad starts on the Enemy Base. How many: the squads that hold the base (roles with a number) plus as many field squads as the player may have on the map (rules.json board_scale; playtest round 16). Roles in placement order: a number, or "rest" for whatever is left of that total. Leader and base guard hold the base; field squads march out to take buildings (EnemyAI, weights in ai.json). Builds are 4 units with no healers: a stage 3 leader and three stage 2 Serf-line units; [class, row], the first unit able to lead leads.
_victor_pause_ticks: An enemy squad that beats one of yours stands still this many ticks (30 game minutes; 2 hours until the user cut it to a quarter, 2026-11-15) before moving on, so you can reach it for a second battle (playtest round 10).
_base_revive_ticks: An enemy squad standing on the Enemy Base brings back one fallen unit (leader first, at full HP) every this many ticks (2 game hours). Living units don't heal there (enemy_base rest 0 in buildings.json).
_return: Playtest round 19 (user, 2026-11-15): a wiped-out enemy squad comes back at the Enemy Base at full strength after travel_share of the time it would take that squad to march from where it fell to the base (its speed with no one fallen, by its travel type). A squad driven off (Demand they flee) stays gone. The Warlord's fall ends the map first.
